name: SMS Scale Model Competition
description: Proudly presented by SMS Paint, see the best scale model builds Queensland has to offer at the Scale Model Build Competition & Expo. Don't forget to vote for your favourite entry. Admire and take photos but please don't touch.

name: Brisbane RC Mini and Micro Buggy Racing
description: Casual racing social outings for Micro and Mini scale (1:28-18) Scale Offroard RC Cars. We welcome everyone to come on down to our indoor carpet track at Salisbury for relaxed afternoon of racing.

name: Gunpla Brisbane Build Group
description: Representing Brisbane's Gunpla building community, Gunpla Brisbane Build Group meets regularly for social building and welcomes new members, online discussion and in person build meets.

name: Brisbane Display Painters Guild
description: Brisbane Branch of Australian Display Painting Guilds. Community group focused on improving miniature painting, especially with a focus to paint for display purposes.

name: Brisbane Miniature Enthusiasts Association Inc. (BMEA)
description:
BMEA is a non-profit group of people of all ages.
We share interests in scale doll house building, scale models, dioramas and anything miniature related. We meet as a club on a monthly basis in Everton Park to share ideas and skills, attend workshops, and create together.

name: IPMS QLD
description: IPMS Queensland is a group of like minded modelling enthusiasts who like to meet, share and discuss all things scale modelling!

name: Riverside Scale Modellers
description: Based in Bullimba RSMC is a scale model group open to all that are interested in model building and community

name: Diagon Alley
description: A stunning scale version of the iconic Diagon Alley from Harry Potter

name: Australian Air League
description: The Australian Air League is a youth group for girls and boys aged 8 years and older with a passion for flying.

name: Tweed Valley Modellers
description: Tweed Valley Modellers - scale modelling club that spans multiple genres of modelling

name: Swordcraft
description: Swordcraft Brisbane is a LARP (Live Action Roleplay) community playing every Friday night in Brisbane Queensland, and is a chapter of Swordcraft Ltd, Australia’s largest Not For Profit Live Action Roleplay & Battlegame.

name: Bris Bricks
description: Check out the latest creations from the build masters at BrisBricks

name: Garage Gamers
description: Step onto a tabletop battlefield and bring history to life! Historical miniature wargaming lets you move tiny soldiers across hills, rivers, and villages, recreating real battles with strategy, drama, and artistry.

name: Gerry Anderson Model Expo by Jim Millet
description: See iconic models from the worlds of Thunderbirds, Captain Scarlet, and more — all built by professional model maker Jim Millet!

name: MakR Gallery
description: A showcase of non-competition work and builds from the community including all creative mediums.

name: Trading Card Zone
description: Enter the Trading Card Zone by Vault Games If you've ever wanted to learn Magic: the Gathering, Star Wars: Unlimited, Disney's Lorcana, or the new Riftbound: League of Legends Card Game, or you just have a deck with you, this is THE zone for you. Join the crew from Vault Games as they take you through the ins and outs of these games at one of the demo tables or join in the fun with casual Commander, Twin Suns, Pack Rush, Preconstructed Deck Battles, or on-demand Sealed and Draft across the whole two days of GhMX. Score Prize Tickets for participating in events, and even more for winning,

name: Cosplay Studio
description: Includes Cosplay X Registration, Cosplay Repair, Photo Area & Change Room

name: Brick Pit & Exhibitor Lounge
description: A free & open area to let your imagination go wild with Lego bricks

name: RC Zone
description: Get hands on with RC helicopters, planes, an indoor buggy racing track and fully usable construction equipment in the GhMX sandpit!

name: Misfits United
description:
Misfits United is a gaming and pop-culture social enterprise, incorporated as part of the Redcliffe Area Youth Space. We are a Youth Service dedicated to working with marginalised and disadvantaged young people with a strong focus on social inclusion.
Our store is unique in that it is worked and run by young people for young people.

name: Wendy1305AU
description: 3D Printed book themed items along with Dice towers, dice, critters and fidgets.

name: Traders Galaxy
description: Traders Galaxy produces its own tabletop miniatures and games in Qld.

name: Neural Forge
description: Neural Forge produces unique strategy games for all levels of gamer. Each set is made in house with high quality materials and is designed to look great on your table even when not in use.

name: MJL Anime
description: We are a Brisbane based retailer. We provide delicious anime & manga-inspired merchandise to satisfy all your otaku needs. Awesome items such as Figures from small to large scale, Zoids Model Kits, Trading Cards, Danmei and some rare collectibles that have been specially imported from overseas can be found. Make sure to come and say hi~

name: Kiza Collective
description: A family business that focuses on 1990s-2000s generation toys Mainly Selling rare 1st Edition Beyblade, 1st Edition English and Japanese Pokémon cards, Yu-Gi-oh Cards, 1st Generation Digimon Device, original 1990s Star Wars action figures, Crush Gears And more.

name: Talisman Sabre Terrain
description: We provide a highly detailed and immersive 3D printable hex terrain system compatible with Dungeons & Dragons, Gloomhaven, Frosthaven etc. Our terrain is OpenLOCK and magnet compatible. We can provide printed and painted terrain sets for customers or you can purchase the digital files to print your own.

name: Manscale Models
description: High quality scale model tools and accessories based in Upper Caboolture.

name: Brisbane Tolkien Fellowship
description: Tolkien/Hobbit/Lord of the Rings Fan Club

name: Dragonfire Creations
description: Dragonfire Creations is where craftsmanship meets imagination. We proudly design and produce our own line of dragons, dice towers, jewellery, and resin works — while also showcasing exceptional designs from other skilled creators. Whether handmade or carefully curated, each piece is crafted to inspire your next great adventure.

name: Ausdice
description: Our mission at Ausdice is to enrich tabletop gaming adventures by providing dice and accessories that inspire creativity, enhance gameplay and foster memorable moments among players of all ages and interests.

name: WWW.EDENHUNTER.COM.AU
description:
The place to be for the largest variety of Htsune Miku & Anime figures. 
Stop by and try your luck at our ICHIBAN KUJI wall where you could win a statue worth $200+ for only $20! Every ticket wins a prize (prizes vary per set) so you wont go away empty handed. 
We will also have some Gundams and Trading cards as well so make sure to check out what hidden gems you'll find.

name: Great Ball Collectibles
description: We specialise in Pokemon TCG as an authorised retailer and have a wide selection of singles for collectors of all budgets.

name: Vault Games
description:
Unlock the Vault! Vault Games is the store that has all your tabletop gaming needs, from board games and miniatures to role-playing and trading card games. Boasting an extensive library of games, you can be sure the Vault team will help you discover new games and also give you an opportunity to pick up anything you've ordered online.

Find us at 62 Queen St Brisbane City and 730 Sandgate Rd Clayfield!

name: 105th Armoury Hobby Shop
description: 105th Armoury Hobby Shop, A place for Collectibles, Model Kits, Gaming and modeling supplies

name: Model Nerds
description: Modelnerds specialise in selling pre loved model kits, decals, accessories. We buy collections.

name: Zombster
description: A great manga and Japanese model kit store, with a large physical store located in Oxley.

name: Bricks & Beyond
description: Retro kits, hard to find gems and spares parts

name: Adam Nichols
description: Meet comic guest artists and designer Adam Nichols famous for his work on Fruit Ninja, Warhammer Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, Clonewars: The Republic Heroes and more.

name: Wayne Nichols
description: Meet comic guest artists Wayne Nichols famous for Marvel Comics, IDW Publishing, Dark Horse Comics and more!

name: Millennium Exile - Ty Hansen
description: Meet graphic novelists and model builder Ty Hansen, writer and illustrator of "Millennium Exile" as well as an award winning Gundam model builder.

name: David Zuppini - Spaced Out
description: Meet comic artists David Zuppini, writer of the independant and hillarious parody comic series "Spaced Out"

name: Info Desk
description:
Info Booth & First Aid. Redeem prizes & enter the Ultimate 
Christmas Hamper raffle. Buy yourself an exclusive GhMX show 
pin!

name: Cassa's Shots Cosplay Photo Booth
description: Official Cosplay Photographer

name: Cosplay Repair Guild
description: The Cosplay Repair Guild is an alliance of caring and fun cosplayers who wish to provide top notch and professional repair service to any and all in need at GhMX.

name: Doctor Who Photo Area
description: Get a photo with the iconic TARDIS from Doctor Who

name: Mischa’s Miniature Bazaar
description: Get your scale model builds photographed by GhMX's official model photographer!

name: Brisbane Metro 1/14 RC Truck & Construction Club
description: Enthusiasts dedicated to all things RC Trucks and Trailers, RC Construction Machines and anything else large and radio controlled! Always happy to speak with attendees and tell you the ins and outs of anything radio contolled with lots of wheels!

name: rcheli.au
description: Take flight with Radio Controlled Helicopters! Discover the thrill of flying, maintaining and mastering these versatile machines that can be flown almost anywhere. Passionate enthusiasts will be at GHMX to share with you the boundless challenges of aeromodelling whilst being part of a vibrant community while elevating your passion for STEM and aviation. Come and have a try of their world class simulator completely free and also enter the draw to win your own RC Heli!

name: Dungeons & Dragons
description: If Dungeons & Dragons is your thing, or you want to see what it's all about, join our team of players and dungeon masters from The Adventure's Guild to teach you the basics and run short matches all weekend.

name: Delta Phase Games
description:
Delta Phase Games is a small indie game studio based in Brisbane, Australia, run by Eris Alar & Josh Huf.

We firmly believe play is an essential part of life, and want to help more people have fun making memories with their friends and family.

name: Arcane Woods
description: Bring your tabletop games to life with an Electronic Table from Arcane Woods!

name: Pokidoll Collectables
description: Pokemon cards, Plush, figures

name: Knifedge Games
description: Knifedge Games is a Brisbane-based board game company who in 2024 released their debut game, We Forlorn Few. We Forlorn Few is a resource management survival game where players race across the American West with a deadly twist that lets fallen players return to hunt down the survivors.

name: Regulation Station
description: Regulation Station is a designated space designed to help individuals manage and regulate their sensory experiences. Also known as a calm corner or sensory corner, this space provides a supportive environment to pause, reflect, and engage in activities that promote emotional balance and self-regulation. Trained staff from Just Support will be in attendance to assist attendees with their specific sensory needs.

name: Magic The Gathering Tutorial Zone
description: Always been curious about playing? You can learn for free and you might end up with a few freebies along the way. Open to all ages.

name: Pirate-Dragon
description: Pirate-Dragon specialises in Ear Cuffs for both pierced and non-pierced ears. We currently have over 3000 different designs and most can be adapted (on request) to suit either pierced on non-pierced ears.

name: Chonkyfriend
description:
Chonkyfriend features art inspired by 2000s Nostalgia, Internet culture and video games. This small buisness sell stickers, pins, art prints and more Illustrated by Brisbane based Artist Jaiden Bowman.

Instagram: chonkyfriend

name: AbFabKreations & The Very Sweary Yarn Faerie
description:
AbFabKreations specialises in weighted plush toys to bring comfort to everyone! Weighted plushies are a wonderful way to moderate over stimulation, and who doesn't love a cute plush?!

The Very Sweary Yarn Faerie specialises in handcrafted, game and monster themed crochet plushies. These cuddly friends are super adorable, and just waiting to go home with you!

name: Jhenneberry arts
description: Hand drawn graphite illustrations, selling prints and potentially original art

name: Mapleforge
description: I am Caitlin (maplefoot) and I run the business MapleForge, we're not just selling stickers – we're offering a gateway to nostalgia and personal expression. Each sticker is a carefully crafted piece of art, embodying the spirit of beloved franchises. Our commitment to quality ensures that these stickers not only look great but also stand the test of time against UV and water exposure. With a diverse selection of over 400 designs, there's something for every fan to connect with. So, whether you're a gamer, TV buff, or pop culture aficionado, there will also be a design that calls your name at the Forge. Let MapleForge be your destination to find and celebrate the iconic weapons and items that have left a lasting mark on your imagination. See you there! • 450 + Varied Sticker designs based on Games, Tv Shows, Comics and Pop Culture • Stickers are High Quality, Scratch Proof , Water Proof and UV resistant • Stickers are sold individually or in Fandom related bundles (e.g Portal Bundle, Hazbin Hotel Bundle, Ratchet and Clank Bundle) • Thick Line art styled stickers that absolutely bring the POP to Pop Culture.

name: Moon Rock Accessories Club
description: Moon Rock Accessories, a brand specializing in unique and high-quality enamel pins. We have a diverse collection of over 300 different pin designs, ranging from anime, cats, and artistic themes to niche collectibles that appeal to a wide audience.

name: Pendragon's Pen
description: Independent author of fantasy and cyberpunk genre stories

name: Blehcado
description: Blehcado is a digital illustrator who loves drawing blocky shapes and funny little guys. You'll find her stall stocked with prints, comics, notepads, stickers and plenty more. If you've got original character cards, head on over and trade!

name: Confetti Carousel
description:
Confetti Carousel is a size inclusive Harajuku and Alternative Fashion brand. Think cute and colourful fashion, jewellery and accessories to brighten your style.
Everything is handmade by Mari in her Brisbane studio.

name: Dragonfly Relics
description: Handmade dice and accessories for gamers, miniatures and jewellery.

name: Fatal Encounters
description: Play an authentic murder investigation in the murder mystery made by cops. The first case comes with forensic tools used to reconstruct crime scenes. Swap hats from CSI to detective once you find the killer's mistake and sleuth through the suspect profiles and evidence. With real investigation techniques as puzzles, use criminal profiling, crime scene stories, and a whole online police database to draw conclusions and reveal the hidden killer.

name: Fatal Encounters
description: Hand drawn graphite illustrations, selling prints and potentially original art

name: Fc3D
description: We offer 3D printed cosplay and also offer bespoke cosplay design

name: Need Moar Dragons
description: Wooden Ttrpg storage and accessories including dice towers, boxes, and trays. Unique gift ideas for gamers and lovers of dragons. From Book boxes, journals and Treasure chest, all wooden, all handmade on the Gold Coadt

name: plump_n_pretty
description: Cosplayer | Fabric Hoarder | Multi-Award Winner | Rhinestone addict Plump_n_Pretty Cosplay! Bringing characters to life for almost 15 years (and somehow still have my sanity… mostly). I love building elaborate costumes to the point it has become an addiction.

name: Softtbxnny
description: Professional bunny enthusiast, caffeine connoisseur, and part time fictional character impersonator

description: Cosplayer - Multi-Award Winner - Coffee lover - Dog Mum
